body:
It started out as a joke, everyone was tripping on some shrooms and we started talking.  Smoke Crack?  Lets smoke rocks!! Everyone agreed jokingly, and we laughed about it throughout the night.  We joked about the idea of smoking crack for 2 weeks, making dumb jokes and such.  But when the third week rolled around, we had some coke and some baking soda.....how could we resist it....we had everything we needed for a nice batch of crack cocaine.
When we started stirring it up in the spoon, I'm pretty sure we were all asking ourselves if it was really happening...we were going to smoke crack? YES! YES!  We mixed up 2 parts coke and 1 part baking soda (hydrochloride) we added a couple drops of water.....and then we heated the spoon.....slowwly the precipitate crack came to the top, we scrapped it off, and let it cool.
It formed into a nice big rock and we put her in our nice little crack pipe....I put the pipe to my lips, took the lighter and light that rock up.  The crackling was so so loud, it sounded like roaring as the crack smoke filled my lungs....and then the euphoria, the swirving, the orgasmic feelings running up and down my spine, exploding into infinity.....best 5 minuets EVER.  I passed the pipe and we all took quite a few hits, and can safely say we all got incredibly high. I can see why its so addictive!
There you go folks, good times smoking some crack cocaine here in the midwest.....
